title: Crispy Vegan Skillet
description: A flavorful and crunchy vegan skillet dish made with polish sausages and served with a side of tangy zesty slaw.

ingredients.name: vegan oil
ingredients.notes: such as avocado or canola oil

instructions: Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the polish sausages and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the sausages hot with the zesty slaw on the side.
Garnish with additional slaw if desired.
